acceptance_criteria.criterion: Export produces a versioned manifest and deterministic records for memories, metadata, relationships, and Paperless references.
The portable bundle contains no credentials or document binaries.
Restore into an empty test store recreates the exported semantic graph without duplicate creation on rerun.
Round-trip verification reports record, relationship, and content-hash integrity.

commits.message: test(open-brain-jhg): red -- restore refuses populated target
feat(open-brain-jhg): green -- refuse populated restore target
test(open-brain-jhg): red -- portable bundle excludes credentials and binaries
feat(open-brain-jhg): green -- reject credential-bearing bundle labels
test(open-brain-jhg): red -- restore rerun creates no duplicates
feat(open-brain-jhg): green -- idempotent same-bundle restore rerun
test(open-brain-jhg): red -- postgres and cli portable backup surfaces
feat(open-brain-jhg): green -- postgres and cli portable backup surfaces

tests.command: uv run ruff check src/open_brain/portable_backup.py src/open_brain/data_layer/postgres.py tests/test_portable_backup.py

codex_adversarial_fixes.fix: export_bundle raises ExportTargetNotEmptyError on a pre-existing non-empty target directory (fail-closed, no silent deletion), mirroring the restore-side pattern.

codex_adversarial_fixes.finding: 2 (portable_backup.py:350) verbatim metadata could leak nested credential keys
codex_adversarial_fixes.fix: Added recursive _scan_forbidden_keys + _assert_no_forbidden_content; export RAISES ForbiddenExportContentError on credential-shaped keys nested anywhere in exported records (extends the paperless binary-key fail-closed precedent).

codex_adversarial_fixes.finding: 3 (portable_backup.py:389) restore did not validate manifest before writing
codex_adversarial_fixes.fix: restore_bundle now runs _verify_bundle_manifest (version compatibility, per-file SHA-256, and per-file record counts) before any store call; raises IncompatibleBundleVersionError / BundleIntegrityError.

codex_adversarial_fixes.finding: 4 (portable_backup.py:390) emptiness check ran outside the write transaction (TOCTOU)
codex_adversarial_fixes.fix: Moved emptiness/same-bundle check into postgres restore_portable_records under LOCK TABLE ... IN EXCLUSIVE MODE in the same transaction as the write; portable_backup delegates and reports already_restored.

codex_adversarial_fixes.finding: 5 (portable_backup.py:324) full-record hash omitted fields; indexes count-only
codex_adversarial_fixes.fix: _memory_record_hash now covers all MEMORY_FIELDS; added relationship full-record comparison (record_mismatches) covering link_type/confidence/metadata; indexes compared by (id,name) set (missing/extra).

codex_adversarial_fixes.finding: 6 (portable_backup.py:394) matching rerun returned success before embedding regen
codex_adversarial_fixes.fix: postgres restore_portable_records regenerates embeddings for memories missing an embedding on the already_restored no-op path when regenerate_embeddings=True.

codex_adversarial_fixes.finding: 7 (postgres.py:1728) export reads lacked a consistent snapshot
codex_adversarial_fixes.fix: export_portable_records wraps the three reads in one REPEATABLE READ transaction via a shared _read_portable_closure helper.

Sequence repair stays in the same transaction as the inserts and now runs under the EXCLUSIVE table lock (finding 4), serializing it against concurrent nextval; GREATEST(MAX(id)+1,1) never collides with an existing row. Documented in code.

scope_changes.description: No merge or force restore mode was added.
scope_changes.reason: The bead explicitly scopes merge/force behavior out.

scope_changes.description: A same-bundle rerun against an already restored target is treated as a verified no-write no-op.
scope_changes.reason: This preserves the fail-closed non-empty-store refusal for mismatched stores while satisfying the acceptance criterion that rerun creates zero duplicates.

scope_changes.description: The optional lossy Markdown view was not implemented.
scope_changes.reason: It was explicitly optional, generated last, and droppable; all authoritative bundle and verification requirements were completed.

downstream_impacts: The bundle format starts at bundle_format_version 1.0.0 and includes manifest counts, JSONL hashes, credential/binary assertions, and embedding model metadata.
verify_round_trip returns the locked structured report for downstream open-brain-m9e consumption.
Canonical entity metadata and Paperless references round-trip through verbatim metadata export and restore.
